node.title: Budget-three antipodal harmonic-torsion characteristic sieve
node.statement: Four power-of-two roots with pairwise distinct squares cannot have cross-ratio -1 in characteristic zero: the cleared equation is an eight-term vanishing sum, and divisibility by X^(N/2)+1 forces antipodal pairing, which distinct squares make impossible. At the official lift order 2^40, every finite survivor therefore lies in the bad characteristics of one explicit integer unit-ideal certificate. A repeated-squaring presentation has 126 variables, 127 cubic-or-lower equations, and no dense degree-2^39 polynomial. No certificate or official exclusion is claimed.
